summary: A lone individual activated an emergency distress signal about five miles south of the lower South Fork creek trailhead and was trapped on the side of a mountain, unable to move up or down due to high, fast water. A four-man SAR team and a two-man ground team got within two miles of the GPS coordinates but could not cross the creek; a Classic Air Medical helicopter out of Los Alamos, NM searched two hours without locating him. A Flight for Life helicopter from Durango located him, dropped provisions for the night, and returned the next morning to extract him, completing the mission at 9:50 a.m.
location: ~5 mi south of the lower South Fork creek trailhead
responding_agency: Conejos County Sheriff's Office; Conejos County Search and Rescue; USFS law enforcement; Classic Air Medical; Flight for Life
notes: Year inferred: June 10 fell on a Monday in 2024 (matching the article's notification-Monday / stalled-Monday / FFL-5:45-p.m. / extraction-Tuesday sequence), and the Citizen's story ID places it between its Feb-2024 and Jul-2024 stories. Recorded at the distress-signal date.
